versions.changelog:
- Updated the initial base URL confirmation message to English: now asks, "The default service-management base URL is https://aicadegalaxy.com/agent. Should I use this URL?"
- No other functional, workflow, or API changes.

- Updated API endpoints to new signed AICADE gateway routes under /admin/gateway/services.
- Registration request format switched to camelCase fields; snake_case is no longer accepted.
- All operations now require signed requests using both AICADE_API_KEY and AICADE_API_SECRET_KEY (with signature headers).
- The "disable service" operation is updated to PATCH /admin/gateway/services/{serviceId}/status?enabled=false (not POST /services/disable).
- Improved environment variable checks and user prompts; do not repeatedly ask for already-set values.
- Removed legacy file: skill-card.md.

aicade-create-service 1.0.0

- Initial release with guided flows for registering, updating, querying, and disabling aicade services via /services endpoints.
- Checks for required local environment variables (AICADE_API_KEY, AICADE_WALLET_ADDRESS) before prompting users.
- Collects registration data through multi-step confirmations to ensure correct service metadata, billing, rate limits, and auth configuration.
- Validates critical fields and prevents common mistakes before generating curl requests or Node.js command examples.
- Includes clear workflow guidance and API reference usage for consistent, error-resistant service management.
